title: Make a folder and move the files of one kind into it

setup.why: A fresh folder with jan.csv, feb.csv, notes.txt, todo.txt, run.log and build.log, and no subfolder, shown in a Finder window.

instruction: In Finder, in the folder computer-bench-{{nonce}} (in Documents), make a folder named "{{folder}}" and move all the .{{kind.ext}} files into it. Leave the other files where they are.

checks.why: The new folder exists and holds exactly the files of the asked kind (ls, hidden files such as .DS_Store not listed).
Beside the new folder, the top folder holds exactly the other four files: nothing else was moved, deleted or copied.

teardown.why: Close the Finder windows on the folder and its subfolder.

argv: tell application "Finder" to close (every Finder window whose name is "computer-bench-{{nonce}}" or name is "{{folder}}")

oracle.why: Make the folder and move the files of the kind into it.
